method: Run identical consequential operator prompts against the pre-revision and revised skill in clean read-only clones, grade only the response artifacts against literal assertions, repair instruction gaps, and rerun unchanged prompts with an independent grader.

failures: Did not explicitly recheck recorded artifact size as well as SHA-256.
Did not bind every required source, master, evaluation, validation, and plan identity literally.
Did not state that failure to recover evidence is not proof of nonexistence.
The same three requirements remained implied rather than explicit in agent responses.

changes: Require byte-size and SHA-256 receipt verification in the resume instruction.
Name the complete schema-2 release identity chain.
Make not-recovered versus nonexistent an explicit evidence rule.
iterations.stop_reason: All unchanged prompt assertions passed under strict independent grading, while the executable bank remained available to detect contract regressions.

limitations: This comparison measures instruction-following on synthetic scenarios, not live Apple Photos behavior.
The same model family generated responses for both skill variants; the grader was a separate ephemeral run.
Raw response artifacts remain local and are not required for normal repository checks.
